{{Top|leg}}
'''Pearl Hat''' was a nickname for [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guards]] such as [[Pars Varqom]]. Varqom worked as a Palace Guard for 18 years; during the reigns of seven [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarchs]], from [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] through [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Mairayni]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], writer of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', eventually cut any mentioning of Pearl Hat in the final product. The title was later made [[canon]]ical in the [[StarWars.com]] blog post [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'': Author's Cut, Part 6 — Showdown at Naboo'']].
